anchors.name: Pier Head
anchors.source: NLS OS London 1:1056, sheet VII.88 (1872): the Pier Head houses stand at (12, 12) and (14, 12), with no OHM street on any side, so the starting house is on the nearest lot beside one (decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18): Green Bank at (16, 10). Real houses at (12, 12)-(14, 12), sharing (14, 12) with the Town of Ramsgate. In game they sit at (16, 12) [INVENTED].
anchors.history: [INVENTED] Workers' housing: the Pier Head houses were built c.1811 for officials of the London Docks. Moved from (12, 12) to (16, 12), the nearest lot beside a street, so the starting house has one (D-079, D-084).

anchors.name: Oliver's Wharf
anchors.source: NLS OS London 1:1056, sheet VII.88 (1872); the wharf touches Well Alley (decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18, D-084)
anchors.history: [INVENTED] Game cell; the real warehouse of 1869-70 is at (16, 14) [HE 1065806].

anchors.name: St John's Church
anchors.source: NLS OS London 1:1056, sheet VII.88 (1872); it shares the cell with Green Bank (OHM)
anchors.history: [FACT] Rebuilt 1756 [HE 1241683]; the first church is of 1615-17.

anchors.name: Town of Ramsgate
anchors.source: NLS OS London 1:1056, sheet VII.88 (1872): no label on the sheet; the inn stands beside Wapping Old Stairs
anchors.history: [FACT ±1] The inn beside Wapping Old Stairs; its cell may be off by one (confirmed by Chronicler, 2026-10-18).

named_sites.name: Thames Police Station
named_sites.history: [FACT] Site of the Thames (Marine) Police since 1798; its present building, of 1907-10, is HE 1242394. A named site with no building.

named_sites.name: Wapping Old Stairs
named_sites.history: [FACT] River stairs named on the sheet; a named site with no building.

period_houses.name: Period house 1
period_houses.source: The cell is in the north-west corner of sheet VII.77, which has no 1862-74 edition (option A of 2026-10-18): placed by hand on a free lot beside the street at (8, 8)-(8, 11) (decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18, D-083)
period_houses.history: [INVENTED] One of four 1870 workers' houses around the street at (8, 8)-(8, 11) (D-083): no sheet of 1862-74 shows this cell. The simulation places it as dense housing that starts empty and is never demolished (D-085).

damaged_wharves.name: Damaged wharf
damaged_wharves.source: Read on no sheet: a river cell beside the street at (28, 12), away from Oliver's Wharf (20, 16) and the Thames Police (24, 14) (decision of Cristian, 2026-10-18, D-083)
damaged_wharves.history: [INVENTED] A wharf in disrepair, believable for 1870, with no name of a real wharf; it fronts the real Swan/Sun Wharf frontage; not one of them.

history_notes: [DEBATED] The Thames comes from OHM way 188212040, which has no start_date: its banks are taken as those of 1870.
[INVENTED] The Wapping lock (Wapping Entrance) does not fit at 25 m a cell, so Wapping Basin stays closed from the river (plan B of Mason): no water is added and the free-cell count does not change.

[INVENTED] Lot styles are assigned by hand, not read on the sheets: timber yards along the Thames, yards by the docks and inside the London Docks wall (1805), gardens inland, and plain on the cells of a real place of the sheets, like Oliver's Wharf (16, 14), the Thames Police (24, 14), Pier Head (12, 12) and Wapping Old Stairs (14, 14) (D-083). Only drawing.
